innovation.summary: The project introduces innovative bioprocessing techniques that address inefficiencies in traditional food processing. It features the development of novel enzymes and methodologies, including the first all-aqueous biocatalyst for peptide bond synthesis, which breaks a long-standing industry bottleneck. The integration of AI technology in enzyme design further enhances the project's innovative approach.
key_points: The enzyme 新 肽合成酶 is the first all-aqueous biocatalyst for peptide bond synthesis, breaking a 30-year industry bottleneck.
Targeted bioprocessing using fermentation enhances quality, improves flavor, utilizes waste, and increases efficiency.
The project has developed a series of new computational chemistry algorithms and tools for calculating energy changes in complex biological catalytic systems.
The SMART platform is an internationally leading industrial enzyme design platform driven by AI and key control point calculations.
The project claims to have the only enzyme that can withstand a feed granulation temperature of 85 degrees Celsius.
A molecular modification design method to improve the substrate selectivity of prolyl endopeptidase has been developed.
